newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test, USDA said. Inquiry was fairly strong and demand light.
Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter steers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 83,900 head including 24,200 head or about 29 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 66.00.
Confirmed - 300 last week - none last week - none
